name: Sixup Lending LLC
description_short: Sixup provides gap student loans up to $15,000/year for high-achieving students, requiring only a 3.0+ GPA with no co-signer or credit history needed.
description_long:
Sixup Lending LLC is a personal loan provider listed in the CreditDoc directory. The company's website was not reachable during our review, so we could not independently confirm current products, pricing, licensing status, or operating hours. This profile page exists so consumers researching Sixup Lending LLC can find the contact record on CreditDoc.

Because we could not verify the site, this page does not describe specific loan products, rates, or service details. Consumers considering Sixup Lending LLC should contact the company directly to confirm what services are currently offered and at what cost, and to request written disclosures for any product before signing.

Consumer lenders are licensed at the state level. Verify licensing with your state's consumer credit or financial regulation office and check the CFPB Consumer Response Profile before applying.
pros: No co-signer required, addressing a major barrier for first-generation and low-income students
No credit history required for approval—unique among private student lenders
Borrow up to $15,000 per academic year to cover tuition and education expenses gaps
Merit-based pricing: better grades can qualify you for lower interest rates
No origination fees, reducing upfront borrowing costs
Free unlimited tutoring included with loans
Additional support services: resume writing, internship placement help, and career coaching
cons: Only available in 17 states plus Washington, D.C., severely limiting geographic access
Minimum 3.0 GPA requirement excludes students with lower academic performance
Higher interest rates compared to federal student loans and some private alternatives
Limited track record: BBB notes short operational history compared to established competitors
best_for: First-generation college students without family financial resources or co-signers
High-achieving, low-income students with 3.0+ GPA attending top-tier colleges
Students in covered states needing gap funding between tuition costs and financial aid
Immigrant students building U.S. credit history for the first time
diagnosis: Sixup is best for high-achieving, low-income students in covered states who need gap funding and lack access to traditional private student loans due to absent credit histories or unavailable co-signers. The primary caveat is severe geographic limitation (17 states + D.C.) and a strict 3.0 GPA minimum that excludes many borrowers, combined with higher interest rates than federal alternatives.
services: Private student gap loans ($2,500–$15,000 per academic year)
Merit-based interest rate pricing based on GPA and academic records
Nonprofit foundation (Sixup Foundation) educational tools and resources
Loan approval without credit history or co-signer requirements
